name: Deploy, Replace, Undeploy
abstract: Core requirements class for OGC API — Processes Part 2 (DRAFT). Specifies the fundamental operations a server must support to dynamically deploy, replace, undeploy processes, and retrieve the last application package used to deploy or replace a process: POST /processes, PUT /processes/{processID}, DELETE /processes/{processID}, and GET /processes/{processID}/package.
